description: The compatible contract lines of the Data Layer V2 protobuf module. A record contract's schema_digest is the digest of its LINE, not of the current proto file: it changes only when a release changes the module incompatibly (buf breaking, FILE rules, against the line's frozen baseline image) and opens a new line. Additive changes stay in the line. The real sha256 of market_data.proto is recorded separately as schema_file_sha256 (audit only, never lineage). Tool: scripts/schema_line.py.

lines.note: The digest every V2 stable role has carried since the stable candidate (QDL_STABLE_SCHEMA_DIGEST = sha256 of market_data.proto at fc5e29e, 2026-08-19). Later proto changes (7b5f222, b1965b1, 1a2daf1, v2.3.0 Bar.aggregation 74ea7e2) are additive and pass buf breaking against this image.
